zh-CN.title: 更沉浸的影像浏览
items: 聊天与广场现已使用同一套图片和视频详情页
新增适配手机的黑色沉浸预览，点击任意位置即可退出
影像记录支持横向浏览更多拍摄与视频参数

en.title: A more immersive media viewer
items: Chat and Square now share one image and video detail experience
A mobile-friendly dark immersive view now closes with a tap anywhere
Media records can be swiped horizontally for more capture and video details
